about.description: nSCOPE is the receipt token for Nest’s Hamilton Lane SCOPE vault, providing tokenized exposure to Hamilton Lane’s Senior Credit Opportunities Fund, an evergreen senior private credit strategy focused on first-lien senior secured loans with diversified multi-manager sourcing and periodic liquidity. The attached source sheet shows active contracts on Plume, BNB Chain, and Solana. Nest’s smart contract docs later published a separate multichain nSCOPE BoringVault address on Plume, Ethereum, Plasma, and BNB, so the tracked contracts here follow the attached sheet for consistency.
